summary: Added a moderator-only Reported items filter to the existing forum index. It includes a topic when the topic or any reply is reported, including hidden moderator-visible items; filtering occurs before the existing sort and page-size slice. The controller supports the app's generic rendered-button payload by toggling when enabled is omitted, accepts explicit booleans, rejects other supplied types and non-moderator calls, and clears the filter when moderator role exits.
